scope: Read-only peer review of opt-in contact/amount service lifecycle integration and execution prerequisites. No provider/GPU execution performed by this review.
checks: Contact and amount are explicit opt-in measurements; default suites do not load these datasets or require phonenumbers.
Selected dependency and frozen corpus/source validations run before output creation, GPU lease, GPU inspection or subprocess creation.
Pinned phonenumbers9.0.14 is required only for contact; amount-only remains independent of that optional package.
Both selected commands cover all test/OOD documents without a limit and execute contact before amount.
Commands pass verified model, method, base revision, checkpoint SHA256 and saved calibration temperature.
Server identity is checked before measurement and between stages; a healthy identity-valid server permits amount to run after a nonzero contact result.
Measurement failure/log records are preserved, own child processes are stopped, and selected physical GPU cleanup is checked before the next model.
Existing contact/amount evaluators construct B from the actual A choice, never a gold-selected candidate; unchanged evaluator code retains stage errors and full extraction denominators.

Documentation requires completion/audit/release of the active core stages, separate pinned checkout, frozen corpora/producer files, isolated phone dependency, fresh output paths and serial GPU3 execution with max_length16384/batch_size1.
Documentation states that the commands do not themselves wait for the core supervisor or audit gate, and do not represent a completed model evaluation.
limitations: CPU tests/preflight are implementation and data checks, not model-quality evidence.
This review did not provision a checkout, alter the active supervisor, acquire a GPU or run an HTTP service.
Future deployment must satisfy the documented scheduling and audit prerequisites and record its pinned commit/checkpoint identities.
